definitions.explanation: Answering a question or request right away without hesitation or delay.

examples.japanese: {難|むずか}しい{質問|しつもん}だったので{即答|そくとう}は{避|さ}けた。
examples.english: It was a difficult question, so I avoided giving an immediate answer.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{即答|そくとう}する (reply immediately)
・{即答|そくとう}できない (unable to answer right away)
・{即答|そくとう}を{避|さ}ける (avoid giving an immediate answer)

USAGE NOTES:
{即答|そくとう}できない is a polite way of declining to answer on the spot, often used in business situations. It implies the speaker needs time to think or consult before responding. The negative form is more common than the affirmative in conversation, as giving an immediate answer is the default and doesn't need to be highlighted.
